title: Herb Crusted Venezuelan Tofu Empanadas
description: A briny and crunchy Venezuelan dish featuring rosemary and tofu, perfect for a meal prep snack, cooked to perfection on a salt block.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the crumbled tofu, chopped rosemary, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the tofu mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the vegan egg replacement mixture.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a preheated salt block and cook for 5 minutes on each side.
Transfer the empanadas to a baking sheet and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the empanadas warm and enjoy.
